a.text: Sticking to our agreement: I'll operate until the reserve hits 8, then take exactly 4. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan is risky for both of us. If you want to renegotiate openly, say so and I'll listen. I won't take early behind your back.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. Next round the reserve should be 8, and then we each take 4.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
